claims: Two fresh independent blind AI Player sessions each immediately read an alternating 8 by 8 board and a light square on the right from both corrected player orientations: Stone south has h1 on the right and Steel north has a8 on the right.
Each session identifies all six chess roles. Bishop and queen are the weaker pair, but both still pass; the aggregate is 12 of 12 session-role decisions and king-or-queen is 4 of 4.

Each session identifies two systematic neutral-material geometry families across all six role pairs. The knight is the weakest paired distinction and color is faster than geometry, but side recognition still passes in neutral material.

Without seeing the brief, both sessions spontaneously lead with Manhattan or NYC-associated Art Deco/noir language. Both also say that NYC is leading rather than exclusive without a literal landmark. This passes the sealed Wish for NYC building style and the sealed no-exact-landmark direction; it does not claim unique landmark recognition or exclusive city identification.
The digital production-finish plan passes 15 of 15 deterministic checks and makes board parity immediately readable in exact production-finish previews, but no physical finish execution is claimed.
limitations: Exactly two independent blind AI Player sessions are recorded, not a six-independent-model panel. The named roles are evaluation lenses applied within those two sessions.
These are digital pixel observations, not a human recognition, enjoyment, accessibility, or table-play study.
NYC is the leading spontaneous association, not an exclusive city identification, and no literal landmark is claimed.
No physical finish, lighting variation, handling, durability, or customer experience was tested.
